scope: Offline development-fixture validation and study plan; no agent adoption experiment was run. The source pool is named here and measured on demand.

sourceIdentity.retention: Record the command's output with each run manifest; it identifies the source contents that run actually read.

development.executionFixtures: scenario-definitions-only; full project snapshots not yet materialized

holdout.requirement: Author separately after freezing the treatment; keep prompts and scoring outside development workspaces. Public development fixtures are not a holdout.

observedFriction.issue: Historical first-try context conditions both include the full reference.
observedFriction.implication: They do not isolate compact, on-demand retrieval.

observedFriction.issue: Existing first-try jobs require Semiotic; they do not measure an appropriate library choice.
observedFriction.implication: Choice and negative-fit trials require their own rubric and controlled source pool.

observedFriction.issue: Static rendering cannot establish live subscription cleanup, reconnect, or correction behavior.
observedFriction.implication: Live tasks require browser lifecycle checks in addition to a static oracle.

contextProfiles.interpretation: Each profile is a fixed bundle of source files. The inventory command reports their UTF-8 byte sizes for the current contents; neither the bundle nor its size is evidence of interactive retrieval quality.

prerequisites: Materialize each scenario's starting application or artifact in an isolated fixture and record its hashes; the current public bank contains scenario definitions, not complete project snapshots.
Approve model identity, current pricing, total spend cap, and task-level limits before any provider calls.
Use a harness that enforces cumulative token, tool-call, wall-time, and billed-cost limits across each agent session.
Freeze the implementation and source pool; randomize condition and option order in fresh project workspaces.
Provide jobs and allowed source files only; exclude fixtures, expected answers, scorer code, and this study's baseline.
Prespecify accepted choices and evidence obligations with a reviewer separate from the treatment author when available.
